prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original transparent production U-shaped wall shell sprite for an existing top-down 2.5D game kiosk.
Input image 1 is the current GAME screenshot with user-marked side-wall seam defects. Use its cream plaster/sage steel art style, but replace the broken side-wall geometry. Input image 2 is the approved kiosk concept, showing the intended rectangular interior shell.

Draw ONLY a single CONTINUOUS connected U-shaped exterior wall shell: north wall across the full top, full uninterrupted WEST wall down the left, full uninterrupted EAST wall down the right. SOUTH/bottom is fully OPEN because a separate front facade contains the entrance and counter. NO west door gap or east door gap anywhere, no standalone lower pier. Full interior is true alpha transparent.
Axis-aligned almost top-down orthographic GAME camera like both references. Rectangle width:depth approximately 1.88:1. No diagonal isometric rotation, no vanishing point. North back wall has a shallow front face occupying about top 34% of shell depth. Left and right side-wall strips occupy about 6.25% of shell WIDTH each, matching each other, straight and parallel. Full-width north wall joins both sidewalls seamlessly at top corners. Sidewall INNER edges remain absolutely vertical and straight from the north-wall junction to their bottom endpoints. Sidewall OUTER edges also absolutely vertical.
Materials: aged cream plaster with restrained muted sage metal outline/coping and narrow inside-edge trim. North wall has slim sage upper coping, cream upper face and a modest sage lower band. Side walls are narrow top surfaces of cream plaster with slim sage continuous edging, not distorted copies of the front facade. Sidewall paint and edging run CONTINUOUSLY the entire length with no horizontal green straps crossing a sidewall midway, no large bracket, no extra detached green rail, no sudden width steps, no hanging strip or diagonal corner wedge. Only two small clean steel corner plates at the NORTH top corners, fully inside the wall silhouette; no other protruding hardware. Side walls end neatly on the SAME horizontal bottom line, ready to meet the separate south front facade.
Important repair requirements: same width on left/right; no kink at height of old door; no stretched end-cap fragments; no broad green color block halfway down either sidewall; no alpha hole inside the sidewall silhouettes. Make every sidewall read as ONE structural piece. No floor, doorway, door leaf, roof, shelves, cabinets, counters, cashier, player, signage, labels or other fixtures.
Transparent alpha outside the U shell and throughout its empty interior; no colored background or baked room rectangle. Neutral overhead daylight, detailed matte hand-painted game style, crisp modest outlines and scuffs, no glow/cast shadows outside silhouette. Full shell visible with small transparent margins. This is a production sprite, not a concept board.
